title: eCommerce System Map
description: Interactive map of catalog eCommerce models, checkout flow, and module capabilities. Pan, zoom, and click nodes for details.

help.title: About the eCommerce system map
help.overview: The system map is a picture of the catalog eCommerce module: its models, the checkout flow, and what the module can do. It does not change data. The marketplace has its own map.

sections.title: Model graph
sections.body: This is the default tab. It is the data model, laid out so you can see what points at what.
items: Pan and zoom, or use the zoom and fit controls.
Click a node for its fields, the API path, and where that screen lives in the panel.
Filter the graph by the catalog, ordering, payments, escrow, and shared groups when the full map is too much.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: This tab is the checkout story, from the catalog to the order, rather than the list of models.
items: Follow it when you want the order of steps: product, cart, payment, stock, shipment.
It is the same module the other eCommerce menu entries operate. It is not a second checkout.

sections.title: Capabilities
sections.body: This tab groups what the module covers, so you can see the surface area without opening every menu.
items: Use it to find which area a job belongs to, then open that page from the eCommerce menu.
Catalog settings such as categories, warehouses, and discounts live under Configurations, not in this menu group. The map still shows them, because the catalog uses them.
